 6. (a) Draw three large cylinders to fill up the drawing paper
 (b) Paint the three cylinders, each using a different colour: red, blue, and green.
 (c) For each cylinder, use dark and light tones to create volume.
 (d) Blend the colours smoothly from dark to light to make the cylinders look three-dimensional.
 A sample picture of a cylinder is shown below.
 Materials Needed:
 • Paints (blue, red, and green)
 • White paint
 • Black paint
 • Paintbrushes

 • A4 sheet of paper or drawing book
